police.speaker: Detective Morris
police.text: Morris evacuates the upper floor and finds a second hidden exit.

signal.speaker: Amara
signal.text: Amara maps a dry pocket behind the eastern retaining wall.

alone.speaker: David
alone.text: David finds three scratches at a child's height behind the wall panel.

dialogues.speaker: David
dialogues.text: The flood channel runs under a warehouse that is marked for demolition. Water is rising through the lower stairwell.

dialogues.speaker: Amara
dialogues.text: A toy boat floats past with a new message: "Not the room. The wall."

dialogues.speaker: Victor
dialogues.text: The panel opens. From the other side, Ethan whispers: "Dad" Don't come in yet.

choices.label: Call Morris to clear the upper floor
choices.impact: Morris can evacuate the upper floor, but the hidden room may be lost in the search.
choices.response: Morris: I will clear the building and keep the eastern exit open.
choices.speaker: Detective Morris

choices.label: Ask Amara to map the channel flow
choices.impact: Amara can find the dry pocket, but rising water may close the route behind David.
choices.response: Amara: I will map the current and tell you when the water changes.
choices.speaker: Amara

choices.label: Search the wall before the water rises
choices.impact: David can inspect the wall now, but there may be no time to wait for backup.
choices.response: David: I will check the scratches and stop if the water reaches the stairs.
choices.speaker: David

metadata.episode: A continuing rescue mystery; the final clue opens the next episode.
